jobs.title: Budgeting Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Accountabilities:**

* Prepare several reports for budget preparation (Historical reports & Peers)

* Following up on the data collection process within time frames.

* Assists with projecting future financial needs and collaborates with budget manager and other management personnel to prepare long-term financial plans, and other budget and financial reports.

* Prepare budget analysis and recommendations to upper-level management at the beginning of each budgetary cycle.

* Prepare departmental expenditures status in comparison to original budget.

* Assist in preparing budgeting status reports for committees and stakeholders

* Assist in preparing high-quality dashboards and PowerPoint presentations to be presented to our board members and senior management to be approved from their side.

* Periodical reporting of Budgeting insights to relevant Business stakeholders

* Follow all relevant approved department’s policies, and procedures and monitor adherence so that work is carried out in a controlled manner.

* Follow the day-to-day operations related to own jobs in the department to ensure continuity of work.

* Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal EG Bank policies and code of conduct to maintain EG Bank’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance & Accounting or a related field. -related certifications are considered an asset
* 2 or 3 years of experience in Finance Field, Preferred exposure in Budget & performance
* Experience within Banking Industry will be considered as an asset

**Skills:**

* Excellent command of English and Arabic languages (written and spoken)

* Excellent communication skills
